sellsword.name: Sellsword
sellsword.tagline: You fought for coin until the coin stopped meaning anything. Strong, stubborn, hard to kill.

shade.name: Shade
shade.tagline: A cutpurse, a liar, a survivor. You were quick, charming, and never quite where people looked.

ashwright.name: Ashwright
ashwright.tagline: A scholar of the burning arts, who learned to pull fire out of ash. Brilliant and fragile.

lightbearer.name: Lightbearer
lightbearer.tagline: A wandering cleric of the Dawnfather, whose prayers still sometimes work. Steady and kind.
